run_mrp_genmsgs_process: run the mrp process that generates ROS message Python bindings using genmsg_py
build_conda_runtime_with_genpy: build a Conda runtime with ros-noetic-genpy to generate ROS message Python code
create_genmsg_py_command_list: create a command list for genmsg_py to compile .msg files into Python modules
use_noescape_for_env_vars: use mrp.NoEscape to preserve shell environment variable references like CONDA_PREFIX
run_mrp_main_entry: run mrp.main to execute the defined genmsgs process from the command line
